text_block_list.text: And so, the three years I spent racing alongside Red Desire came to an end.

Before long—the day arrived for the Saint
to cross the sea and challenge the world.
The "Breeders' Cup." A world-class trial where only the chosen elite gather—something Red Desire had yearned for so long.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Rounding the fourth corner, under 400 meters to go!
Into the home stretch! Coming from the outside,
Red Desire! Red Desire!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "It's a neck-and-neck race!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "And now—they cross the finish liiine!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She couldn't quite stretch out in the final stretch, Red Desire...!
A bitter defeat in 4th place...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaah... *gasp*... haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even after awakening,
she still cannot reach—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The wall to the world...
is this formidable—!"

Though she took on the BC in peak condition,
she was unable to grasp the radiant light of victory.
—Even so.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "DESIIIIRE!!!"

Having fought valiantly against the world's greatest,
Red Desire was met with
the highest praise imaginable.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
there are still trials...
standing in our way.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—Onto the next.
Next time, I will conquer it without fail.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This world—!

Again and again, as many times as it takes.
All you must do is keep challenging it until you overcome it.
"For there is no trial that Saint Red Desire cannot overcome."
Some time has passed since the fierce battle at the BC—

The diagnosis came in: the "Crimson Wedge"
that had been plaguing Red Desire's body
was now virtually healed.
Rising above her narrow defeat at the BC... she has forged her resilient spirit into something even stronger.
Now that is the Saintly Maiden Red Desire I believed in.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
I am still an inexperienced Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, my story
is not permitted to end—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The trials to reach the 'Otherworld'
shall continue from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
You who adored the Saint and always supported her...
You are someone truly special.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Will you join me once more...
and enjoy this path of harsh trials?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ufufu~♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then let us go forth.
My beloved Trainer.

"With every trial overcome,
stronger, nobler,
that soul is polished into beauty."
Captivating this world.

And so, eventually this world
shall become the world the Saintess is destined to reach.

Until the day we finally reach it...
our three-legged journey will continue.
